questions: आपका नाम क्या है? | Aapka naam kya hai? | What is your name? | Who is your name? | Where is your name? | Which is your name?
मेरा नाम सरफराज है। | Mera naam Sarfraz hai. | My name is Sarfraz. | I name is Sarfraz. | Me name is Sarfraz. | My names Sarfraz.
आप किस क्लास में पढ़ते हैं? | Aap kis class mein padhte hain? | Which class do you study in? | What class do you study? | Where class do you study? | How class do you study?
मैं 10वीं कक्षा में पढ़ता हूँ। | Main 10th kaksha mein padhta hoon. | I study in 10th class. | I am study in 10th. | I studied in 10th class. | I am studying in 10th.
आप कहाँ रहते हैं? | Aap kahan rehte hain? | Where do you live? | What do you live? | Where are you live? | Where you live?
मैं दिल्ली में रहता हूँ। | Main Delhi mein rehta hoon. | I live in Delhi. | I am live in Delhi. | I lived in Delhi. | I am living in Delhi.
आपके पिता क्या करते हैं? | Aapke pita kya karte hain? | What does your father do? | What do your father do? | What is your father do? | What your father doing?
मेरे पिता डॉक्टर हैं। | Mere pita doctor hain. | My father is a doctor. | My father are doctor. | My father doctor is. | My father be doctor.
आपकी माता क्या करती हैं? | Aapki mata kya karti hain? | What does your mother do? | What do your mother do? | What is your mother do? | What your mother doing?
मेरी माता एक हाउसवाइफ हैं। | Meri mata ek housewife hain. | My mother is a housewife. | My mother are housewife. | My mother is housewife. | My mother be housewife.

सिंपल प्रेजेंट टेंस का मुख्य उपयोग क्या है? | Simple Present tense ka mukhya upyog kya hai? | Habits, daily routines, or facts. | Only for future plans. | Only for past actions. | To describe actions happening right now.
सिंपल प्रेजेंट टेंस की पहचान क्या है? | Simple Present tense ki pehchan kya hai? | ...ता है / ती है / ते हैं. | ...रहा है / रही है / रहे हैं. | ...चुका है / चुकी है. | ...से रहा है.
सिंपल प्रेजेंट टेंस का बेसिक इंग्लिश रूल क्या है? | Simple Present tense ka basic English rule kya hai? | Subject + Verb. | Subject + is + Verb. | Subject + was + Verb. | Subject + has + Verb.
सिंगुलर सब्जेक्ट (He/She/It) के साथ वर्ब में क्या जोड़ा जाता है? | Singular subject (He/She/It) ke saath verb mein kya joda jaata hai? | Add s/es. | Add ed. | Add ing. | Nothing is added.
वह स्कूल जाता है - इसका सही इंग्लिश अनुवाद क्या है? | Vah school jaata hai - iska sahi English anuvaad kya hai? | He goes to school. | He go to school. | He going to school. | He gone to school.

हम क्रिकेट खेलते हैं - इसका सही इंग्लिश अनुवाद क्या है? | Hum cricket khelte hain - iska sahi English anuvaad kya hai? | We play cricket. | We plays cricket. | We playing cricket. | We played cricket.

'He goes to school' में वर्ब के साथ 'es' क्यों लगा है? | 'He goes to school' mein verb ke saath 'es' kyon laga hai? | Because the subject 'He' is singular. | Because it is a past action. | Because it is a question. | Because it is plural.

दिए गए इमेज में 'Simple Present Tense' को किस नाम से पुकारा गया है? | Diye gaye image mein 'Simple Present Tense' ko kis naam se pukara gaya hai? | The Routine Floor. | The Live Camera Floor. | The Clock Tense. | The Past Floor.
वह स्कूल जाता है - इसका रोमन हिंदी क्या है? | Vah school jaata hai - iska Roman Hindi kya hai? | Vah school jata hai. | He school go. | Vah school going. | Vah school ja raha hai.
हम क्रिकेट खेलते हैं - इसका रोमन हिंदी क्या है? | Hum cricket khelte hain - iska Roman Hindi kya hai? | Hum cricket khelte hain. | We cricket play. | Hum cricket khel raha hai. | Hum cricket khela.

आपके परिवार में कितने सदस्य हैं? | Aapke parivar mein kitne sadasya hain? | There are 5 members in my family. | There be 5 members in family. | There has 5 members in my family. | There is 5 members in my family.
आपके पिता क्या करते हैं? | Aapke pita kya karte hain? | My father is a teacher. | My father be a teacher. | My father are teacher. | My father is teacher.
आपकी माता क्या करती हैं? | Aapki mata kya karti hain? | My mother is a homemaker. | My mother be a homemaker. | My mother are homemaker. | My mother is homemaker.

आपके बड़े भाई क्या काम करते हैं? | Aapke bade bhai kya kaam karte hain? | My elder brother is working as a software engineer. | My elder brother working software engineer. | My elder brother is work as software engineer. | My elder brother be working as software engineer.
आपकी कितनी बहनें हैं? | Aapki kitni behnein hain? | I have two sisters. | I has two sisters. | I am two sisters. | I have two sister.

आपकी बड़ी बहन के बारे में क्या जानते हैं? | Aapki badi behan ke baare mein kya jaante hain? | My elder sister is married. | My elder sister be married. | My elder sister married. | My elder sister has married.

आपकी छोटी बहन क्या कर रही हैं? | Aapki choti behan kya kar rahi hain? | My younger sister is pursuing her graduation. | My younger sister pursuing her graduation. | My younger sister is pursue her graduation. | My younger sister be pursuing her graduation.
आप साथ में क्या करते हैं? | Aap saath mein kya karte hain? | We love spending time together. | We loves spending time together. | We is spending time together. | We love spend time together.
आप सब क्या खेल खेलते हैं? | Aap sab kya khel khelte hain? | We play games. | We plays games. | We is play games. | We playing games.

आप अपने परिवार के बारे में कैसा महसूस करते हैं? | Aap apne parivar ke baare mein kaisa mehsoos karte hain? | I love my family very much. | I loves my family very much. | I am love my family very much. | I love my family very many.
आप सुबह कब उठते हैं? | Aap subah kab uthte hain? | When do you wake up in the morning? | When you wake up morning? | When do you waking up? | What time you wake up morning?
क्या आप सुबह जल्दी उठते हैं? | Kya aap subah jaldi uthte hain? | Do you wake up early in the morning? | Do you waking up early? | Are you wake up early? | Does you wake up early?

उठने ke baad aap kya saaf karte hain? | Uthne ke baad aap kya saaf karte hain? | What do you clean after waking up? | What you clean after wake up? | What do you cleaning after wake up? | What does you clean after wake up?
क्या आप रोज़ ब्रश करते हैं? | Kya aap roz brush karte hain? | Do you brush your teeth everyday? | Do you brushing your teeth? | Does you brush your teeth? | Are you brush your teeth?

आप ब्रश करने के बाद क्या करते हैं? | Aap brush karne ke baad kya karte hain? | What do you do after brushing your teeth? | What you do after brush teeth? | What does you do after brush? | What are you doing after brush?
क्या आप रोज़ नहाते हैं? | Kya aap roz nahate hain? | Do you take a bath everyday? | Do you taking bath? | Are you take bath? | Does you take bath?

नहाने ke baad aap kahan jaane ke liye taiyar hote hain? | Nahane ke baad aap kahan jaane ke liye taiyar hote hain? | Where do you get dressed to go after taking a bath? | Where you get dress go bath? | Where do you getting dress after bath? | Where does you get dressed after bath?

क्या आप स्कूल के लिए तैयार होते हैं? | Kya aap school ke liye taiyar hote hain? | Do you get dressed for school? | Do you getting dress school? | Are you get dressed school? | Does you get dressed school?
आप सुबह का नाश्ता कब करते हैं? | Aap subah ka nashta kab karte hain? | When do you eat your breakfast? | When you eating breakfast? | When does you eat breakfast? | When are you eat breakfast?
क्या आप नाश्ते में फल खाते हैं? | Kya aap nashte mein fal khate hain? | Do you eat fruits in breakfast? | Do you eating fruit breakfast? | Are you eat fruit breakfast? | Does you eat fruit breakfast?
आप स्कूल किसके साथ जाते हैं? | Aap school kiske saath jaate hain? | With whom do you go to school? | With who you go school? | With whom you going school? | With who you going school?

क्या आप अपने दोस्तों के साथ स्कूल जाते हैं? | Kya aap apne doston ke saath school jaate hain? | Do you go to school with your friends? | Do you going school friend? | Are you go school friend? | Does you go school friend?
आप कक्षा में क्या करते हैं? | Aap kaksha mein kya karte hain? | What do you do in class? | What you do in class? | What does you do in class? | What are you doing in class?

क्या आप कक्षा में ध्यान से पढ़ाई करते हैं? | Kya aap kaksha mein dhyan se padhai karte hain? | Do you study carefully in class? | Do you studying carefully class? | Are you study carefully class? | Does you study carefully class?
आप दोपहर का भोजन कब करते हैं? | Aap dopahar ka bhojan kab karte hain? | When do you have your lunch? | When you having lunch? | When does you have lunch? | When are you have lunch?
आप शाम को कहाँ खेलते हैं? | Aap shaam ko kahan khelte hain? | Where do you play in the evening? | Where you play evening? | Where does you play evening? | Where are you playing evening?

क्या आप शाम को दोस्तों के साथ खेलते हैं? | Kya aap shaam ko doston ke saath khelte hain? | Do you play with friends in the evening? | Do you playing friend evening? | Are you play friend evening? | Does you play friend evening?

खेलने ke baad aap kaun sa karya karte hain? | Khelne ke baad aap kaun sa karya karte hain? | Which work do you do after playing? | What work you do after play? | What work does you do after play? | Which work are you doing after play?
आप रात का खाना किसके साथ खाते हैं? | Aap raat ka khana kiske saath khate hain? | With whom do you eat dinner? | With who you eat dinner? | With whom you eating dinner? | With who you eating dinner?
क्या आप रात को जल्दी सो जाते हैं? | Kya aap raat ko jaldi so jaate hain? | Do you go to bed early at night? | Do you going bed early? | Are you go bed early? | Does you go bed early?
आप सुबह कितने बजे उठते हैं? | Aap subah kitne baje uthte hain? | What time do you wake up in the morning? | What time you waking up? | What time does you wake up? | What time are you wake up?

क्या आप सुबह सात बजे उठते हैं? | Kya aap subah saat baje uthte hain? | Do you wake up at seven o'clock in the morning? | Do you wake up on seven o'clock? | Are you wake up at seven o'clock? | Does you wake up at seven o'clock?

उठने ke baad aap kahan jaate hain? | Uthne ke baad aap kahan jaate hain? | Where do you go after waking up? | Where you go after wake up? | Where does you go after wake up? | Where are you go after wake up?
क्या आप सुबह कसरत करते हैं? | Kya aap subah kasrat karte hain? | Do you do exercise in the morning? | Do you doing exercise morning? | Are you do exercise morning? | Does you do exercise morning?

कसरत karne ke baad aap kya khaate hain? | Kasrat karne ke baad aap kya khaate hain? | What do you eat after doing exercise? | What you eat after do exercise? | What does you eat after do exercise? | What are you eating after exercise?

क्या आप सुबह की हवा का आनंद लेने बाहर जाते हैं? | Kya aap subah ki hawa ka anand lene bahar jaate hain? | Do you go outside to enjoy the morning air? | Do you go outside enjoy morning air? | Are you go outside enjoy morning air? | Does you go outside enjoy morning air?
आप पार्क में किससे मिलते हैं? | Aap park mein kisse milte hain? | Whom do you meet in the park? | Who you meet in park? | Whom does you meet in park? | Whom are you meet in park?
क्या आप अपने दोस्तों से मिलते हैं? | Kya aap apne doston se milte hain? | Do you meet with your friends? | Do you meet your friends? | Are you meet your friends? | Does you meet your friends?

दोस्तों से मिलने ke baad aap kiske liye taiyar hote hain? | Doston se milne ke baad aap kiske liye taiyar hote hain? | For what do you get ready after meeting friends? | What you get ready after meet friend? | What do you get ready after meet? | What does you get ready after meeting?

आप अपनी ऑफिस कैब का इंतज़ार कहाँ करते हैं? | Aap apni office cab ka intezaar kahan karte hain? | Where do you wait for your office cab? | Where you wait for office cab? | Where does you wait for office cab? | Where are you waiting for office cab?
